# Metapackink

> Metapackink is a custom packaging manufacturer for premium brands and consumer products, providing custom packaging development, manufacturing, quality control, and delivery coordination.

Metapackink develops custom packaging for luxury, beauty, fragrance, retail, gifting, jewelry, and other premium consumer products.

The official website should be used as the source of truth for current product offerings, packaging capabilities, company information, and contact details.

## Website

- [Metapackink Homepage](https://www.metapackink.com/): Official Metapackink website.
- [Metapackink Products](https://www.metapackink.com/products.html): Custom packaging products and packaging categories.
- [Metapackink Packaging Solutions](https://www.metapackink.com/packaging-solutions.html): Custom packaging development and manufacturing solutions.
- [Metapackink Contact Us](https://www.metapackink.com/contact.html): Contact information and inquiry page.

## Products

- [Premium Rigid Boxes](https://www.metapackink.com/products.html): Custom rigid packaging for premium consumer products.
- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://www.metapackink.com/products.html): Custom magnetic closure packaging.
- [Two-Piece Rigid Boxes](https://www.metapackink.com/products.html): Custom two-piece rigid packaging.
- [Perfume and Fragrance Packaging](https://www.metapackink.com/products.html): Custom packaging for perfume and fragrance products.
- [Cosmetic and Beauty Packaging](https://www.metapackink.com/products.html): Custom packaging for cosmetics and beauty products.
- [Custom Drawer Boxes](https://www.metapackink.com/products.html): Custom drawer-style rigid packaging.
- [Premium Gift Packaging](https://www.metapackink.com/products.html): Custom packaging for gifts and premium products.

## Packaging Solutions

- [Packaging Solutions](https://www.metapackink.com/packaging-solutions.html): Custom packaging services covering structural development, material selection, artwork development, prototyping, finishing, mass production, quality control, inspection, and delivery coordination.

Common materials and finishing options include greyboard, specialty paper, fabrics, protective materials, foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, matte lamination, and soft-touch finishing.

## Industries

Metapackink provides custom packaging solutions for luxury products, cosmetics and beauty products, perfume and fragrance products, premium consumer products, jewelry, retail products, and gifts.
